detail.longDescription: Working with 2 AI agents + 3 dev teams right now. Guess who gets the hard stuff? The agents. 🦾 Why? They're faster, available 24/7, never forget context, and don't need hand-holding. Humans have limited hours, energy dips, and skill gaps. Agents just execute. If devs don't adapt soon, I might stop working with them altogether. AI perf is on another level. 📈 # AI # FutureOfWork # DevLife # Productivity
